mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TEAM_MEMBER TM JOIN TEAM T ON TM.TEAM_NUM = T.TEAM_NUM WHERE TM.USER_NUM = #{userNum} AND TM.JOIN_STATUS = 1 AND T.STATUS != 3
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT KC.CARD_NUM) FROM KANBAN_ASSIGN KA JOIN KANBAN_CARD KC ON KA.CARD_NUM = KC.CARD_NUM WHERE KA.USER_NUM = #{userNum} AND KC.STATUS = 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MM.MINUTES_NUM) FROM MEETING_MINUTES_ATTENDEE MMA JOIN MEETING_MINUTES MM ON MMA.MINUTES_NUM = MM.MINUTES_NUM WHERE MMA.USER_NUM = #{userNum} AND MM.STATUS = 1
SELECT TODO_CATEGORY_NUM, USER_NUM, CATEGORY_NAME, COLOR FROM TODO_CATEGORY WHERE USER_NUM = #{userNum} ORDER BY TODO_CATEGORY_NUM

SELECT PT.TODO_NUM, PT.USER_NUM, PT.TODO_CATEGORY_NUM, PT.TITLE, PT.CONTENT, PT.DEADLINE, PT.PRIORITY, PT.COMPLETE, TC.CATEGORY_NAME, TC.COLOR AS CATEGORY_COLOR FROM PERSONAL_TODO PT LEFT JOIN TODO_CATEGORY TC ON PT.TODO_CATEGORY_NUM = TC.TODO_CATEGORY_NUM AND PT.USER_NUM = TC.USER_NUM WHERE PT.USER_NUM = #{userNum} ORDER BY PT.COMPLETE ASC,
PT.PRIORITY DESC, CASE WHEN PT.DEADLINE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, PT.DEADLINE ASC,
CASE WHEN PT.DEADLINE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, PT.DEADLINE DESC, PT.PRIORITY DESC,
PT.PRIORITY ASC, CASE WHEN PT.DEADLINE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, PT.DEADLINE ASC,
CASE WHEN PT.DEADLINE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, PT.DEADLINE ASC, PT.PRIORITY DESC,
PT.TODO_NUM DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PERSONAL_TODO ( TODO_NUM, USER_NUM, TODO_CATEGORY_NUM, TITLE, CONTENT, DEADLINE, PRIORITY, COMPLETE ) VALUES ( SEQ_PERSONAL_TODO.NEXTVAL, #{user_num}, #{todo_category_num, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{title}, #{content}, #{deadline, jdbcType=DATE}, #{priority}, 1 )
